product.olivetti-philos-22-color.summary: The colour version of the Philos 22 offered by Olivetti in Japan.
product.olivetti-philos-22-color.history: The November 1993 issue of ASCII included the Philos 22 Color in the range Olivetti used to expand its presence in the Japanese PC-compatible market.
product.olivetti-philos-22-color.archite: The built-in pointer made an external mouse optional. The ASCII transcription lists a 25 MHz i486SL, 4 MB RAM and an 84 MB disk for Japan.
product.olivetti-philos-22-color.verifie: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-philos-22-color.limitat: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
